spec_match.rationale: Three-strip titlebar with the canonical drag-zone/no-drag-controls CSS shown verbatim — the minimal correct pattern for the property.

interactive.rationale: The menu and window-control buttons in the no-drag strips respond to clicks, demonstrating the clickable-controls half of the pattern.

edge_cases.rationale: The basic pattern is clear but in-tab vs installed behavior and inheritance pitfalls are left to sibling pages without linking the caveat here.

conformance.rationale: Feature-level suite renders honestly at 3 pass / 3 fail.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless CDP 2026-08-16: clicked menu/minimize/maximize controls; page responded with zero console errors.

accessibility.rationale: The window-control buttons are named only by glyphs (—, □, ×) with no accessible names.

openQuestions.title: Give the mock window controls accessible names
openQuestions.detail: aria-label="minimize"/"maximize"/"close" on the glyph buttons; screen readers currently hear punctuation.

guidanceConsulted.query: review pass: accessible live output, honest capability fallbacks, keyboard operability for existing concept demo
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Verify semantic controls, live-region announcements for async state, visible focus, and honest unsupported states rather than fake success.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Review-only critique (no frontend change shipped with it): the rubric applied this guidance as the review bar; the page itself was not modified.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Headless-Chrome CDP drive of the page's controls on 2026-08-16 with console/network capture.

summary: Driven headless 2026-08-16: clicked the mock titlebar controls in the no-drag strips; CSS pattern displayed verbatim; zero console errors; glyph-only button names are the one a11y gap.
